purpose: Replace the unsafe linear conditional-power law with an intrinsically positive source-power model while preserving the measured native/difference architecture and checking predictive value before synthesis.

Input targets are actual per-sample squared bandpass outputs divided by TRAIN mean. Fit convex Poisson QUASI-likelihood mean(exp(eta)-target*eta), not a count distribution or acoustic source identity. Each band trained separately, no penalty/clipping/attenuation. solver: Deterministic Newton from allzero coefficients; gradient=X.T@(q-target)/N; Hessian=X.T@diag(q)@X/N. Maximum60iterations; infinity gradient<=1e-9 is convergence. Positive link removes algebraic negative power but cannot prove naturalness or sufficient dynamic detail.
